{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-opw2ln",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The condition that the Utilities air gallery serves RHOB and distributes instrument air to header H-R (where P-R is located) establishes a physical pathway. A drop in pressure at this location caused the alarm.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the air gallery did not serve RHOB or P-R was upstream of that service area, this link would be invalid.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; physical distribution is a prerequisite for local pressure loss to trigger an alarm at that location.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact mechanism causing the drop (upstream vs downstream) remains unknown but does not negate the causal path from condition P-R low -> focal event."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-gybvj2",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm AL-44 activates when pressure drops below 4.5 bar and clears above 5.0 bar. The evidence shows P-R dropped from ~6.8 to <4.1 (below threshold) between 10:00 and 10:03, directly triggering the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure had remained above 4.5 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; alarm logic is deterministic based on threshold crossing.",
      "evidenceGap": "The specific physical cause of the pressure drop (valve state change vs upstream supply loss) remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1myxjth",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Upstream pressure P-U remained stable at 6.9 bar while local indication P-R dropped, indicating the focal event was caused by a localized issue downstream of P-U (within RHOB distribution path or valve state change), not upstream source failure.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If P-U had dropped, the focal event would be attributed to upstream supply loss rather than a localized downstream issue.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; stable upstream pressure rules out source failure as cause of this specific drop pattern.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact physical mechanism (valve position change vs blockage) causing P-R drop remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-16kxawb",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "No line opening was authorized at the time of interruption. This condition enabled the focal event by ensuring no intentional isolation procedure (LOTO) or planned maintenance release had occurred to account for potential pressure loss during work preparation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a line opening had been authorized and properly executed, the pressure loss might have been expected or mitigated by isolation procedures.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; lack of authorization is consistent with work being paused unexpectedly rather than planned maintenance release.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether an unauthorized valve state change occurred remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-2jmrrk",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at notification time. This condition enabled the focal event by indicating that work boundary release had not been formally accepted, meaning no formal isolation or pressure-loss mitigation procedures were in place.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If maintenance acceptance had been signed, formal procedures would likely have accounted for pressure loss risks.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; unsigned signature is consistent with work being paused unexpectedly rather than planned release.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether the unsigned signature was due to oversight or procedural gap remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lq9li6",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Area directory does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time. This condition enabled the focal event by indicating that operators lacked documented knowledge of current system state, increasing risk of unexpected pressure loss during work preparation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the area directory had established current valve positions and pressure availability, operators might have detected or prevented unexpected pressure loss.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; lack of real-time data in static documents is inherent to such records.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether a recent change (valve state) occurred remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1cs3s92",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Desk entries do not log every field operation or identify the point of interruption. This condition enabled the focal event by indicating that operators lacked detailed operational records to trace pressure loss origin, delaying root cause identification.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If desk entries had logged field operations and interruption points, operators might have identified the cause faster.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; limited logging is inherent to shift logs in this context.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether a specific unlogged operation caused pressure loss remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1rww984",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "No documented confirmation of understanding regarding root cause assessment or response steps is present. This condition enabled the focal event by indicating that operators lacked formal acknowledgment of procedures to handle pressure loss, increasing risk of delayed or inadequate response.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If documented confirmation of understanding existed, operators might have followed established response steps more effectively.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; lack of documentation is inherent to this context.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether an undocumented procedure was violated remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1ubp9xd",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB requested Utilities attendance at 10:00; work paused by 10:02. This condition directly caused the focal event's consequence (work pause) as a response to the pressure loss.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If RHOB had not requested attendance or work had not been paused, the consequence would have differed.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; request and pause are direct responses to pressure loss event.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether a communication breakdown contributed remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1hmiwux",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Crew U-A/U-B held current operating qualifications at shift start. This condition enabled the focal event by indicating that operators were qualified but still faced unexpected pressure loss, suggesting qualification alone was insufficient to prevent or detect the issue.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If crew lacked qualifications, the event might have been attributed to incompetence rather than system issue.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; qualification status does not prevent unexpected pressure loss from external causes.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether recent change briefing was received remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-7cbf4",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Daily work briefing topic line read '1SC dryer work and RHOB service coordination'. This condition enabled the focal event by indicating that operators were aware of related tasks but lacked specific configuration details (e.g., valve states) to anticipate pressure loss risks.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If briefing had included specific configuration details, operators might have anticipated pressure loss risks.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; general topic line does not convey detailed system state.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether crew received recent change briefing remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-xuyu0f",
      "toKey": "focal",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Daily work briefing contained no valve-by-valve content. This condition enabled the focal event by indicating that operators lacked detailed system state information to anticipate pressure loss risks during maintenance preparation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If briefing had included valve-by-valve content, operators might have anticipated pressure loss risks.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; general topic line does not convey detailed system state.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether crew received recent change briefing remains unknown."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The focal event (instrument-air low-pressure indication at RHOB) was caused by a localized pressure drop at P-R, triggered alarm AL-44 due to threshold crossing. This condition was enabled by multiple factors: lack of line opening authorization, unsigned maintenance acceptance signature, area directory not establishing valve positions/pressure availability, desk entries not logging field operations/interruption points, no documented confirmation of understanding regarding root cause assessment/response steps, RHOB requesting Utilities attendance/work pause at 10:00 (work paused by 10:02), crew holding current operating qualifications but lacking specific configuration details in daily work briefing (no valve-by-valve content). The upstream pressure P-U remained stable (~6.9 bar) while local indication P-R dropped, indicating a localized issue downstream of the North gallery or within RHOB distribution path rather than source failure.","evidenceUsed":["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1","7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],"unknowns":["Whether a recent change briefing was received or specific configuration drawing used by crew U-A/U-B.","The exact physical mechanism (valve state change vs upstream supply loss) causing P-R drop remains unknown but does not negate causal path from condition to focal event."],"alternatives":["Upstream source failure ruled out due to stable P-U pressure at 6.9 bar while local indication dropped.","Communication breakdown between Utilities and RHOB unsupported by evidence; timing gaps do not establish communication failure as cause of delay.","Work folder blankness does not directly enable focal event but indicates lack of documented procedures for maintenance preparation."],"confidence":0.85},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-1","sourceId:7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#2,claimRef:n-u3hp7x",
    "question\":\"Did crew U-A/U-B receive a recent change briefing or see specific configuration drawing used for 1SC dryer work and RHOB service coordination? This would clarify whether lack of valve-by-valve content in daily work briefing contributed to unexpected pressure loss risk.\","
  ]}
